name: fatou
description: Julia language server, formatter, and linter

fatou.formatting.enable.markdownDescription: Enable Fatou as a formatter. When `false`, Fatou contributes no formatting edits (document and range formatting), so another formatter can own Julia without disabling the extension. The language server keeps running for diagnostics and language features.

fatou.diagnostics.enable.markdownDescription: Show Fatou diagnostics (the linter) in the editor. When `false`, all diagnostics are suppressed, including the parse errors that a `fatou.toml` `[lint]` selection cannot silence. Formatting and language features are unaffected.

fatou.languageFeatures.enable.markdownDescription: Enable Fatou language features: hover, completion, signature help, go-to-definition, references, document/workspace symbols, rename, code actions, call and type hierarchy, semantic tokens, folding, selection ranges, and document links. When `false`, these are suppressed. Formatting and diagnostics are unaffected.

enumDescriptions: Use the binary bundled inside the extension; fall back to downloading from GitHub if none is bundled or `fatou.version`/`fatou.releaseTag` is set explicitly (default).
Look for `fatou` on the system PATH.
fatou.executableStrategy.markdownDescription: Strategy used to locate the `fatou` executable for the language server.

fatou.executablePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `fatou` executable. Only used when `fatou.executableStrategy` is set to `path`.

fatou.version.description: Fatou version to install (for example: latest or 0.2.0).

fatou.releaseTag.description: Advanced override for the exact GitHub release tag (for example: v0.2.0). If explicitly set, this takes precedence over fatou.version.

fatou.githubRepo.description: GitHub repository used for Fatou binary downloads (<owner>/<repo>).

fatou.serverArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed after `fatou lsp`.

fatou.serverEnv.description: Environment variables merged into the Fatou language server process.

fatou.extraPath.description: Extra PATH entries prepended for the Fatou language server process.

fatou.logLevel.markdownDescription: Log level for the Fatou language server. Maps to the `RUST_LOG` environment variable. Leave unset to use the server's default. If `fatou.serverEnv.RUST_LOG` is also set, it takes precedence.

fatou.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the Fatou language server.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run check-types && npm run bundle:prod
scripts.compile: npm run clean && npm run check-types && npm run bundle
